At Inflow, we understand the challenges of ADHD firsthand—which is why our team of clinicians and coaches, many of whom also live with ADHD, created an affordable and accessible solution to help people with ADHD thrive.
Our ADHD app offers personalized coaching, strategies, and knowledge to help you achieve your goals. Discover how Inflow can support you in taking back control and living your best life.
At Inflow, we believe that neurodiverse individuals deserve quality care that's convenient, affordable, and effective. That's why we offer a dynamic,

Our program gives members a better understanding of themselves, coaching and functional tools, and practical strategies for managing ADHD. In addition, the Inflow app offers a safe, stigma-free, and accepting community where our members are encouraged to thrive. So join us and experience the benefits of our program today!

Lisa Woodruff is a productivity and home organization expert motivating and teaching busy women to take back control of their lives. She's the founder and CEO of Organize 365® and hosts a podcast featured as Woman's Day podcast of the month. She has authored several Amazon bestselling books, and is a sought-after trainer and speaker.

Coach and educator, Diane Dempster, is a co-founder of ImpactParents.com, co-creator of Sanity Schools®, and co-author of "Parenting ADHD Now!". She trains and coaches parents and educators of complex kids. Diane received a Master's degree from UMich, and coaching certification from the Institute for Professional Excellence in Coaching.

Educator and coach, Elaine Taylor-Klaus, co-created the Sanity School® behavior therapy program and ImpactParents.com. She authored "The Essential Guide to Raising Complex Kids with ADHD, Anxiety and more", and provides worldwide training and coaching. Elaine hopes to empower parents to guide their children to lead independent and successful lives.
